purpose: Source-graded visual and machine-readable map of proceedings that share procedural lineage, transmitted evidence, asset context or separately alleged conduct.
global_boundary: A connection in this graph is not joinder, accumulation, identity of parties, proof of knowledge, proof of criminality or transfer of findings between proceedings.

edges.why_it_matters: Cambiario 1048/2019 is the civil predecessor to ETJ 163/2020.
edges.boundary: The lineage does not itself establish validity of the title, debt, later enforcement acts or criminality.

edges.why_it_matters: The DP 711/2025 court header expressly records origin proceeding DP 552/2025-00 and the shared NIG.
edges.boundary: Continuation is not an automatic merits adoption of every allegation or annex from the origin file.

edges.why_it_matters: The 13 March 2025 ETJ filing expressly presented the DP 552 complaint/enlargement as a new fact relevant to the execution, valuation and requested nullity/suspension issues.
edges.boundary: A filing proves that evidence/arguments were put before the civil court; it does not prove judicial acceptance or the truth of the allegations.

edges.why_it_matters: Fincas 8584 and 8588 and the physical state/value of Matkator property are recurring factual objects in both lanes.
edges.boundary: The current-room mapping and legal effects require certified registry/cadastral and expert evidence.

edges.why_it_matters: DP 748/2026 alleges autonomous conduct associated with the civil enforcement and therefore shares ETJ source material.
edges.boundary: DP 748 is not an appeal from ETJ and is not the same criminal proceeding as DP 552/DP 711.

edges.why_it_matters: Both criminal routes touch the alleged transformation/identity of Matkator assets and later use of those assets within the ETJ context, but they were initiated at different times against different alleged conduct/perimeters.
edges.boundary: No direct procedural succession, accumulation or transfer of findings is asserted.

edges.why_it_matters: The wider Sun Park/LPB history helps explain the asset setting in which Matkator units were located.
edges.boundary: Matkator is not thereby treated as an insolvent debtor in Concurso 36/2012 and no criminal conclusion is imported from insolvency events.

edges.why_it_matters: ETJ property is physically situated within the wider Sun Park/MYND asset history.
edges.boundary: Context is not procedural joinder or proof that Concurso decisions resolved title to Matkator property.

legend.FILED_PRIMARY_PLEADING: A filing proves submission, not truth
legend.VERIFIED_PROCEDURAL: Procedural relationship established from controlled sources
